question: What is the meaning of leed in relation to official (mandated) indicators and certificates?
description:
LEED stands for Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design, which is a building certification system that assesses sustainability based on environmental aspects. It is not directly related to official (mandated) indicators and certificates. <|ENDINPUT>
